test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and second letter → Difference between the position value according to the English alphabetic series is 2.
 
• Second and third letter → Difference between the position value according to the English alphabetic series is 3.

​​So,​

 
• Option - (1) : SQT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87fec8af60f4f90587f10ae8a0a84638e14bdd2fd3f02b2c1ba43cbbdb7e31a4.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : BEH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29073704148190049b53c7e59fdea83cf1b1c451b25dcd659c0e76ddb86bf156.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : WUX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c398071f6f3ce96d83b0423d15470a111cfecdd873f3b31ed87cef68a6d8dd5a.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : FDG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029ae724dceac8fe24d8a95098b38a6fdb2dc34846ad2b4d263241a5d78213cc.png] 

Here, out of all options only 'BEH' doesn't follow the same logic as given.

Hence, "BEH" is the correct answer.
